column1: # SHIPPED: read by LexiconHazardTagger (hazard_model.py) from model 0.3.0.
# A term match that lies wholly inside one of these phrases is not a report of
# that category, whatever its severity: the phrase names a product type or a
# material, or is an idiom. Only that match is dropped; any other match in the
# same sentence still counts. Phrases are matched in the tagger's normalized
# text, so spelling variants the normalizer folds ("fake nailll") are covered.
# Safety name phrases (colours, feature names) live in safety_false_friends_v1.tsv

# research/HAZARD_SENTENCE_TAGGING_GUIDE.md ("fake nails" is the product type)
# and from the round-1 counterfeit false alarms, so any gain measured on round 1
# is in-sample. Labelling round 2 is the held-out test.
